Until then it is \\\\\"configured, not proven\\\\\":\\\\n  credit it, but do not count it as protection.\\\\n- **Any other service:** answer the reference\\'s \\\\\"Any other service\\\\\" questions, and\\\\n  verify the service\\'s own backup or cross-Region feature in the AWS documentation\\\\n  before you recommend it. ## 3. Strategy

Targets aren't set, so here are the two most likely fits:

| Strategy | Fits if... | What it would mean here | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Backup and restore** | An hours-to-24-hour outage is acceptable | Redeploy the ECS service, network, and secrets from IaC in eu-west-1 when needed; restore RDS/DynamoDB (if confirmed in scope) from the daily cross-Region backup copies already landing in eu-west-1 | Low — mostly the cost of writing and maintaining IaC |
| **Pilot light** | Downtime needs to be tens of minutes, not hours | Keep the network and a stopped/minimal copy of the ECS service pre-created in eu-west-1; if RDS/DynamoDB are in scope, move from backup copies to a cross-Region read replica (RDS) or Global Tables (DynamoDB) kept running but not serving traffic | Medium — a second standing environment plus always-on data replication |
